e.title_en: A browser extension that an agency management system vendor publishes for its own system: it states verbatim that it supports advanced functionality while working inside that system, is published by the vendor, serves a few hundred daily users at a versioned release updated this year, and carries an all-rights-reserved licence with no repository and a package of only twenty-four kilobytes.

e.summary: **Applied Epic Extension**（Firefox 扩展 `applied-epic-extension`）**是一家**保险代理管理系统厂商**为自己的系统发布的**浏览器扩展****——**逐字自述为**「**Support advanced functionality while working in Applied Epic.**」**。**本次实测**：**发布者逐字为 **`Applied Systems`****、**日活 **456****、**版本 **`3.17.1`****、**创建 **2020-10-02**、**最后更新 **2026-04-15****、**⭐ 许可逐字为 **`All Rights Reserved`****、**包体 **24,334 字节****、**⭐ 而**它**没有**仓库地址**（**支持链接**指向**厂商站点**）。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**浏览器里的保险工具**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四处最值得看**：**① **⭐ 这是**厂商给自己的系统发的扩展**——**⭐ 即**「**浏览器扩展**」**在这里**不是**第三方插件**，**而是**厂商**把**一部分功能**放在**浏览器侧**的**交付方式**；**② **⭐ 它的**包体只有 **24KB****——**⭐ 本词条认为**这一点**值得记**：**⭐ 即**它**显然**只是**一个**薄客户端**（**真正的逻辑**在**服务端**）**——**⭐ 与**本轮**另一条**（**包体 **4.8 MB）**形成**鲜明对照**；**③ **⭐ **456 日活**说明**确有**使用者**，**而**其**许可**为**保留全部权利**、**无仓库**——**⭐ 即**内部工具**以**闭源**方式**面向**客户**分发**；**④ **⚠️ **未核实**它**具体做什么**（**⭐ 自述**只有一句**）**——**⭐ 本词条**如实标注**：**这类**扩展**的**真实功能**只能**从**厂商文档**或**实际使用**中获得**。**⚠️ 本次**未安装、**未使用**。
e.summary_hk: **Applied Epic Extension**（Firefox 擴充 `applied-epic-extension`）**是一家**保險代理管理系統廠商**為自己的系統發布的**瀏覽器擴充****——**逐字自述為**「**Support advanced functionality while working in Applied Epic.**」**。**本次實測**：**發布者逐字為 `Applied Systems`**、**日活 456**、**版本 `3.17.1`**、**創建 2020-10-02**、**最後更新 2026-04-15**、**⭐ 許可逐字為 `All Rights Reserved`**、**包體 24,334 位元組**、**⭐ 而**它**沒有**倉庫位址****。**⭐⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**瀏覽器裡的保險工具**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四處最值得看**：**① **⭐ 廠商給自己的系統發的擴充**——**⭐ 即**瀏覽器擴充在這裡不是第三方外掛**，**而是**廠商**把一部分功能放在瀏覽器側的交付方式**；**② **⭐ 包體只有 24KB**——**⭐ 即**它只是一個薄客戶端**，**真正的邏輯在服務端**；**③ **⭐ 456 日活**說明確有使用者**，**而**許可是保留全部權利**、**無倉庫**；**④ **⚠️ 未核實**它具體做什麼**（**自述只有一句**）**。**⚠️ 本次**未安裝、**未使用**。
e.summary_en: This browser extension **is published by an agency management system vendor for its own system**, stating verbatim that it supports advanced functionality while working inside that system. **Measured this round**: published by the vendor, a few hundred daily users, version 3.17.1 created in 2020 and last updated this April, an all-rights-reserved licence, a package of twenty-four kilobytes, and no repository, with the support link pointing at the vendor site. **This entry belongs to the round theme of insurance tooling inside the browser.** **Four things are worth reading: this is a vendor extension for the vendor own system, so a browser extension here is not a third-party add-on but the vendor chosen delivery channel for part of its functionality; the package is only twenty-four kilobytes, which shows it is a thin client with the real logic on the server, in sharp contrast to another extension in this round whose package runs to several megabytes; a few hundred daily users show real usage while the licence reserves all rights and no repository exists, so an internal tool is distributed to customers in closed form; and what it actually does was not verified, its own description being a single sentence, so the real functionality can only be learned from vendor documentation or actual use.** **The extension was not installed or used this round.**
e.body:
**Applied Epic Extension**（Firefox 扩展 `applied-epic-extension`）**是一家**保险代理管理系统厂商**为自己的系统发布的**浏览器扩展****——**逐字自述为**「**Support advanced functionality while working in Applied Epic.**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**浏览器里的保险工具**」**。

**可核实信息（均 Mozilla 扩展登记接口实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 厂商给自己的系统发扩展，**而**这**改变了**「**浏览器扩展**」**在**保险业**里的**位置****——**⭐ 本次实测**其**发布者**逐字为 **`Applied Systems`**、**名称**逐字为 **`Applied Epic Extension`****；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**值得记**：**⭐ 即**在**保险业**，**浏览器侧**的**交付**往往**不是**「**第三方插件生态**」**，**而是**「**厂商把一部分功能搬到浏览器里**」**——**⭐ 故**使用者**遇到的**不是**「**选哪个插件**」**，**而**是**「**我的**系统厂商**提供了**哪一种**入口**」**。**⭐⭐ ② 包体只有 24KB，**而**它的**逻辑**在**服务端****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**版本 **`3.17.1`**、**包体逐字 **24,334 字节****；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**值得记**：**⭐ 即**以**包体大小**可以**粗判**一个**扩展**是**「**薄客户端**」**还是**「**自带逻辑**」**——**⭐ 而**本轮**另一条**保险相关扩展**的包体是 **4.8 MB**（**相差约 **200 倍**）**，**两者**在**数据流**与**隐私面**上**很可能是**不同的东西**。**⭐⭐ ③ 有日活、**但**闭源****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**日活 **456**、**评分次数 **0**、**许可逐字为 **`All Rights Reserved`****、**⭐ 无**仓库地址**（**支持链接**指向**厂商站点**）**。**⭐ 本词条**如实指出**：**⭐ 即**「**有人在用**」**与**「**可被外部审查**」**是**两件事**——**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**若**一个**工作流**依赖**这类**扩展**，**则**它**属于**厂商工具链**的一部分**，**而**不是**可以**自行**替换的**开源组件**。**⭐⭐ ④ ⚠️ 功能**未核实****——**⭐ 自述**只有一句**「**Support advanced functionality**」**，**而**「**advanced functionality**」**到底**是什么**、**它**读取**哪些**页面数据**，**本次**均**未核实**。**⭐ 本词条**据此**如实标注**：**⭐ 这类**扩展**的**真实行为**只能**从**厂商文档**或**实际使用**（**配合**权限清单**）中获得**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[insurancepro-crm]]、**[[brokerflow-renewal-crm]] 与**[[corredor-broker-platform]] 覆盖**代理与**经纪的**业务平台**、**[[titanium-insurance-core]] 覆盖**核心系统**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**代理管理系统厂商**以**浏览器扩展**形态**交付的那一部分功能**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 本条最值得借的四件事**：**① **扩展**要**看清**是**厂商官方**还是**第三方**（**⭐ 本条**为**官方**）**；**② **包体大小**可以**作为**「**薄客户端／**自带逻辑**」的**粗判**；**③ **日活**不能**代替**可审查性**；**④ **权限**与**页面读取范围**要**在使用前**确认**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有安装、**没有使用**该扩展**（**未打开任何**代理管理系统、**未观察任何**网络请求**）**，**故**不主张**其**功能**、**不主张**其**权限使用**是否**适当**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**扩展登记接口返回的**元数据**（**名称、**发布者、**版本、**日活、**许可、**包体大小与**链接字段**）**，**未读**其**包内容**。**③ ⚠️ **未核实**其**与**所提系统**的**官方关系**（**⭐ 本词条**只按**发布者字段**与**支持链接**记录**）**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其**数据处理位置**（**⭐ 只知**包体很小**，**故**推测**逻辑在**服务端**，**并**已标注为**推测**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核实**其**是否存在**付费或**授权前置**要求**。**⑥ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**该扩展**是**厂商工具**，**不是**保险产品**，**也**不是**承保意见**。

## 同类工具

e.body_hk:
**Applied Epic Extension**（Firefox 擴充 `applied-epic-extension`）**是一家**保險代理管理系統廠商**為自己的系統發布的**瀏覽器擴充****——**逐字自述為**「**Support advanced functionality while working in Applied Epic.**」**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**瀏覽器裡的保險工具**」**。

**可核實資訊（均 Mozilla 擴充登記介面實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 廠商給自己的系統發擴充****——**發布者逐字為 `Applied Systems`**、**名稱逐字為 Applied Epic Extension****；**⭐ 即**在保險業，**瀏覽器側的交付往往不是「**第三方外掛生態**」**，**而是「**廠商把一部分功能搬到瀏覽器裡**」**——**⭐ 故**使用者遇到的不是「**選哪個外掛**」**，**而是「**我的系統廠商提供了哪一種入口**」**。**⭐⭐ ② 包體只有 24KB，**而邏輯在服務端****——**版本 `3.17.1`**、**包體逐字 24,334 位元組****——**⭐ 以包體大小可粗判一個擴充是「**薄客戶端**」還是「**自帶邏輯**」**；**⭐ 本輪另一條保險相關擴充的包體是 4.8 MB（**相差約 200 倍**）**。**⭐⭐ ③ 有日活、**但閉源****——**日活 456**、**許可逐字為 `All Rights Reserved`**、**⭐ 無倉庫位址****（**支持連結指向廠商站點**）**——**⭐ 即**「**有人在用**」與「**可被外部審查**」是兩件事**。**⭐⭐ ④ ⚠️ 功能未核實****——**自述只有一句 Support advanced functionality**，**而它讀取哪些頁面數據**，**本次均未核實**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 與池內條目的關係**：[[insurancepro-crm]]、[[brokerflow-renewal-crm]]、[[corredor-broker-platform]]、[[titanium-insurance-core]]——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**代理管理系統廠商以瀏覽器擴充形態交付的那一部分功能**」這一形態**。

**對 RIAA**：**⭐ 四件事值得借**：**① **看清是廠商官方還是第三方**；**② **包體大小可作粗判**；**③ **日活不能代替可審查性**；**④ **權限與頁面讀取範圍要在使用前確認**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有安裝、**沒有使用**該擴充**，**不主張**其功能**，**也不主張**其權限使用是否適當**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只讀擴充登記介面返回的元資料**，**未讀**其包內容**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實**其與所提系統的官方關係**（**只按發布者欄位與支持連結記錄**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實**其數據處理位置**（**只知**包體很小**，**故**推測邏輯在服務端**，**已標註為推測**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實**其是否存在付費或授權前置要求**。**⑥ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 該擴充是廠商工具**，**不是**保險產品**，**也**不是**承保意見**。

e.body_en:
This browser extension **is published by an agency management system vendor for its own system**, stating verbatim that it supports advanced functionality while working inside that system. **This entry belongs to the round theme of insurance tooling inside the browser.**

**Verified information, all measured from the Mozilla add-on registry interface**: **first, this is a vendor extension for the vendor own system, which changes where a browser extension sits in insurance.** The publisher is named as the vendor and the extension is named after its system. **In insurance the browser side is often not a third-party add-on ecosystem but the vendor chosen way of delivering part of its functionality, so what a user faces is not which extension to pick but which entrance their system vendor provides.** **Second, the package is only twenty-four kilobytes, so the logic sits on the server.** The version is 3.17.1 and the package size is measured in tens of kilobytes. **Package size is therefore a rough test of whether an extension is a thin client or carries its own logic, and another insurance-related extension in this round ships a package of several megabytes, roughly two hundred times larger, which suggests the two differ in data flow and in privacy surface.** **Third, it has real users but is closed.** A few hundred daily users are recorded, the rating count is zero, the licence reserves all rights, and no repository exists, with the support link pointing at the vendor site. **Being used and being externally reviewable are two different things, so when a workflow depends on such an extension it depends on part of a vendor tool chain rather than on an open component the user could replace.** **Fourth, what it actually does was not verified**, its description being one sentence about advanced functionality, and which pages it reads was not established either. **For an extension of this kind the real behaviour can only be learned from vendor documentation or from actual use together with a permissions listing.** **Fifth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover agency, brokerage and core insurance platforms, **while this entry supplies the part of an agency management system that its vendor delivers as a browser extension. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **four practices transfer: establish whether an extension is vendor-official or third-party; use package size as a rough test of thin client versus bundled logic; remember that daily users do not substitute for reviewability; and confirm permissions and page-reading scope before use.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the extension was neither installed nor used**, no agency management system was opened and no network request was observed, **so no claim is made about its functionality or about whether its use of permissions is appropriate**. **Second, only the metadata returned by the registry was read**, covering name, publisher, version, daily users, licence, package size and links, **not the package contents**. **Third, its official relationship to the system it names was not verified**, only the publisher field and the support link being recorded. **Fourth, where it processes data was not verified**, the small package size only suggesting that the logic is server-side, which is marked here as an inference. **Fifth, whether payment or licensing is required first was not verified. Sixth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11 and states plainly that the extension is a vendor tool rather than an insurance product or an underwriting opinion.**
